about:
# Easy Crafting

Easy Crafting replaces the profession window in WoW Classic with one that shows what each recipe costs and what it earns. It also builds a shopping list for the materials you need and buys them for you at merchants.

## Features

- **Profit per recipe.** See the Auction House profit for every recipe. Vendor profit is available as an option.
- **Craft queue.** Queue recipes, reorder them, and click **Craft next** to open the right profession and craft the next item.
- **Shopping list.** Add the materials for your queue to a list. At a merchant, buy everything the merchant sells from your list with one click.
- **Break-even prices.** See the lowest price at which a recipe still pays for itself.
- **Sell crafts.** Sell the items you crafted to a merchant with one click.
- **Filters.** Show only the recipes you have the materials for, and show or hide unlearned recipes.
- **Alt professions.** Look up the professions and recipes of your other characters.
- **Bulk buying.** Shift-click an item at a merchant to choose how many to buy.

## Requirements

- WoW Classic, Interface version 16001.
- [Auctionator](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/auctionator), which supplies the Auction House prices.
- Optional: QuestieDB, which adds location data for recipe sources.

## Install

1. Download the latest release.
2. Extract the `EasyCrafting` folder into the `Interface\AddOns` folder of your WoW installation.
3. Restart the game or type `/reload`.

## Usage

Open any profession. The Easy Crafting window opens in place of the standard one.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/easycrafting` | Switch between the Easy Crafting window and the standard window. |
| `/ecsettings` | Open the settings. |

## Settings

Open the settings with `/ecsettings`. These options are available:

| Option | Default |
|---|---|
| Use the Easy Crafting profession window | On |
| Blizzard window style (needs `/reload`) | Off |
| Show unlearned recipes | On |
| Show craftable and merchant counts in the recipe list | On |
| Remember your alts' professions | On |
| Vendor profit in the recipe list | Off |
| Auction House profit | On |
| Shift-click merchant items to buy in bulk | On |

## Data sources and license

Easy Crafting is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The profession data comes from several sources. See [DATA_SOURCES.md](https://github.com/luttman/EasyCrafting/blob/main/DATA_SOURCES.md) for the list.

## [v1.8.0](https://github.com/luttman/EasyCrafting/tree/v1.8.0) (2026-11-17)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/luttman/EasyCrafting/commits/v1.8.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/luttman/EasyCrafting/releases)

- Add addon icon  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Rename to Easy Crafting, add README and release workflow  
    Remove the item tooltip feature, turn vendor profit off by default, and  
    show the estimated time of the crafting queue.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Add Sell crafts, a Have Material filter, and a fixed icon column  
    Selling  
    - Remember each item crafted through Vendor Profit, per character, and  
      list it in a Crafted section on the Queue tab.  
    - Add a Sell crafts button that sells every stack of those items at a  
      merchant, after a dialog that lists the items and the total.  
    - Let an X button drop an item from the list without selling it.  
    Recipe list  
    - Add a Have Material filter that lists the recipes whose main  
      materials are in your bags, ignoring reagents a merchant sells.  
    - Keep the recipe icons in one column whether or not a craft count is  
      visible, so the list no longer shifts sideways while scrolling.  
    Tests cover the default and EllesmereUI themes. Nothing is verified in  
    the game client.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Release 1.8.0: open the right profession from Craft next  
    - When the next craft in the queue belongs to another profession, open  
      that profession and keep the window on the Queue tab, so a second  
      click on Craft next starts the craft.  
    - Decide which profession a recipe belongs to from the bundled recipe  
      data, and ask the game only for recipes the data does not cover.  
    Bump the version to 1.8.0.  
    Tests cover the default and EllesmereUI themes. Nothing is verified in  
    the game client, including whether C\_TradeSkillUI.OpenTradeSkill  
    exists there; without it the old message is shown.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Release 1.7.0: buy full amounts, show products in the queue  
    Purchases  
    - Shift-click Review purchases to list and buy the full amount of each  
      material, not only one stack.  
    - Send all merchant purchases through one queue, one stack at a time  
      and half a second apart. The bulk-buy dialog uses the same queue.  
    Queue and shopping list  
    - Show the crafted item's icon, tooltip, and chat link on craft rows,  
      in place of the profession spell's.  
    Bump the version to 1.7.0.  
    Tests cover the default and EllesmereUI themes. Nothing is verified in  
    the game client.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Release 1.6.0: break-even prices, queue controls, live accent  
    Crafting  
    - Add a Max button for the craft amount; shift-click counts by the  
      most plentiful material.  
    - Show the remaining batch time as minutes and seconds.  
    Reagents  
    - Show the highest unit price that still breaks even, for selling on  
      the Auction House and to a vendor, with an explanation in the tooltip.  
    - Always price merchant reagents from the merchant, never the Auction  
      House, and show the merchant price on their rows.  
    - Link a material in chat on shift-click.  
    Queue and shopping  
    - Add an X button that removes a saved craft.  
    - Add a Search on AH button for the selected recipe's reagents.  
    - Ask for confirmation before a bulk purchase.  
    Window  
    - Repaint when EllesmereUI's accent changes, without a reload.  
    - Use the profession frame's layer and raise as one piece on click, so  
      the window no longer shows through overlapping windows.  
    Bump the version to 1.6.0.  
    Tests cover the default and EllesmereUI themes. Nothing is verified in  
    the game client.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Release 1.5.0: fix combat close and purchases, add queue order  
    Fixes  
    - Stop calling ProfessionsFrame:Hide() in combat, which the game  
      blocks. Hide only the Vendor Profit window and close the profession  
      frame when combat ends.  
    - Replace the merchant purchase popup, which had no Buy button because  
      the BUY constant is missing on this client. The new themed dialog  
      lists each item, its cost, and the total, and reports why a purchase  
      did not go through.  
    Features  
    - Show the crafted item's tooltip on the large recipe icon, and link  
      the item in chat on shift-click.  
    - Fill the crafting banner as a progress bar that advances during each  
      cast.  
    - Keep saved crafts in the order they were added, and add up and down  
      arrows on the Queue tab to reorder them.  
    - Select the bulk-buy amount so that typing replaces it.  
    Bump the version to 1.5.0.  
    Tests cover the default and EllesmereUI themes. Nothing is verified in  
    the game client.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Clean up, add skins, and add bulk buying  
    Cleanup  
    - Remove dead existence guards, the duplicate `native` setting, and  
      duplicated helpers (Money, ItemName, SpellName, DirectReagents).  
    - Cut the settings to nine toggles; the rest are always on.  
    - Remove the gathering reminder, disenchant tools, and whisper drafts.  
    Profession window  
    - Show Recipes, Shopping list, and Queue as tabs.  
    - Put the vendor profit in the recipe header.  
    - Draw the shopping list and queue as rows with +/- on saved crafts.  
    - Show only the skill-up chance in the Skill column.  
    - Close with a direct Hide in combat, where HideUIPanel is blocked.  
    Skins  
    - Follow EllesmereUI's accent and font when it is loaded, fall back to  
      the built-in flat theme, or use Blizzard templates via a setting.  
    - Theme the settings window and dialogs through one shared helper.  
    Bulk buying  
    - Add BulkBuy.lua: shift-click a merchant item to buy many at once.  
    - Show a notice when Multi Buyer is also loaded.  
    Tests cover the default and EllesmereUI themes. Nothing is verified in  
    the game client.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
